title: SelectSeg: Uncertainty-based selective training and prediction for accurate crack segmentation under limited data and noisy annotations
mechanism: A deep-ensemble uncertainty flags likely-wrong crack annotations, training uses only trusted pixels, and the model abstains on uncertain test regions.
adaptation: The 5-seed house and PF ensembles already exist, so uncertainty maps cost no extra training. Ignore a train pixel when all 5 seeds disagree with its label beyond 2 px: label says crack but ensemble p<0.02 within 2 px, or label says background but ensemble p>0.9 on a dark ridge. Retrain. The abstention map becomes a reliability output for the benchmark.
min_experiment: Arm: house model with the ensemble-disagreement ignore mask, 5 seeds. Baseline: house, 5 seeds. Metrics: crack IoU, relF1@2, BMRK crack IoU. Kill if both crack IoU and relF1@2 show no detectable difference. Sanity check on train only: share of the 24 audited cells that get flagged.
evidence: R (from web listing): on real crack datasets with noisy annotations it beats existing methods, and both selective training and selective prediction help. A noisy CRACK500 mask set (10 to 100% of masks noised) is on Mendeley. Exact numbers not retrieved.
prior_overlap: none. The 5-seed ensemble was used only at inference, never to filter training labels.

alt_notes.adaptation: Rank train cells by 5-seed ensemble disagreement with the crack label; unlabel the crack channel of the top 10% (about 24 cells, the audit count) and train them through the existing MT consistency branch. Report coverage vs crack F curve.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: filtered cells as unlabelled + MT. Baseline: house. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU and relF1@2. Kill if crack IoU < house + 0.008. About 8 GPU-h.

alt_notes.adaptation: Use the existing 5-seed ensembles to rank train cells and crack components by disagreement with the label; demote the worst 5 to 10% (the audit flagged 24 of 239 cells) to ignore regions or unlabeled; retrain.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house trained with ensemble-flagged components set to ignore, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU, relR@2 and E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: crack IoU under +0.012 and E1 relF1@2 under +0.02.
